title: Canon registered three new cameras. One may be a digital tribute to the legendary AE-1.
summary: Canon registered three new EOS R cameras. It is rumoured to feature Canon’s first stacked APS-C sensor, a design that moves circuitry behind the sensor for faster readout, enabling higher burst speeds and blackout-free viewfinder shooting.
